title: By the Stone Fountain  (在石喷泉旁)

segments.t: 清澈的泉水在菩提树街雕花石喷泉的水池里轻声潺潺流动。汉娜和凯勒布把水彩卡片和石边仔细对照，而亚瑟则兴致勃勃地望向一条狭窄的侧巷。请先完整听一遍这一幕。
Look at the left side of the watercolor sketch — there is a tiny carved leaf!
Walk around the dry side of the basin, Hannah; do you see it on the stone?
Right here under the spout! A stone leaf pointing northwest up the gentle hill!
Let me read Card Two: Follow the leaf until twelve chimes cast a straight shadow.
Twelve chimes! That has to be the old municipal clock tower three blocks up!
Three blocks up the main street? Nonsense, I know a two-minute shortcut!
Are you sure about this narrow lane, Arthur? My compass says that bends south.
I have lived on Linden Street for twenty years, Caleb, and alleys beat compasses!
Did you remember to pull your reading glasses down before choosing that turn, Arthur?
Who needs reading glasses to recognize a perfectly straight neighborhood lane?
All right, lead the expedition, Captain, while I count every turn in my notebook.
Left past the flower pots, left again past the green fence — where are we going?!
现在我们一步步来解析石喷泉旁的这段对话。
Look at the left side of the watercolor sketch — there is a tiny carved leaf!
'看水彩素描的左边——有一片雕刻出来的小叶子！'
Walk around the dry side of the basin, Hannah; do you see it on the stone?
'汉娜，绕到水池干着的那一侧走走看；你在石头上看见它了吗？'
Right here under the spout! A stone leaf pointing northwest up the gentle hill!
'就在出水口正下方！一片刻在石头上的叶子，正指向西北方向那座缓坡小山！'
Let me read Card Two: Follow the leaf until twelve chimes cast a straight shadow.
'让我来读第二张线索卡：“沿着叶子的方向走，直到十二声钟响投下笔直的影子。”'
Twelve chimes! That has to be the old municipal clock tower three blocks up!
'十二声钟响！那肯定是三个街区外上面那座老市政钟楼！'
Three blocks up the main street? Nonsense, I know a two-minute shortcut!
'沿主街往上走三个街区？别胡扯了，我知道一条两分钟的近路！'
Are you sure about this narrow lane, Arthur? My compass says that bends south.
'亚瑟，你确定要走这条窄巷子吗？我的指南针显示它往南拐了。'
I have lived on Linden Street for twenty years, Caleb, and alleys beat compasses!
'凯勒布，我在菩提树街住了二十年了，小巷可比指南针靠谱！'
Did you remember to pull your reading glasses down before choosing that turn, Arthur?
'亚瑟，你在选那条弯路之前，记得把老花镜拉下来了吗？'
Who needs reading glasses to recognize a perfectly straight neighborhood lane?
'谁需要老花镜才能认出一条笔直的街区小巷呀？'
All right, lead the expedition, Captain, while I count every turn in my notebook.
'好吧，队长，请带队展开这次探险吧，我会在笔记本里记下每一个转弯。'
Left past the flower pots, left again past the green fence — where are we going?!
'过了花盆往左拐，过了绿栅栏又往左拐——我们到底要去哪儿呀？！'
让我们再完整听一遍这一幕。
Look at the left side of the watercolor sketch — there is a tiny carved leaf!
Walk around the dry side of the basin, Hannah; do you see it on the stone?
Right here under the spout! A stone leaf pointing northwest up the gentle hill!
Let me read Card Two: Follow the leaf until twelve chimes cast a straight shadow.
Twelve chimes! That has to be the old municipal clock tower three blocks up!
Three blocks up the main street? Nonsense, I know a two-minute shortcut!
Are you sure about this narrow lane, Arthur? My compass says that bends south.
I have lived on Linden Street for twenty years, Caleb, and alleys beat compasses!
Did you remember to pull your reading glasses down before choosing that turn, Arthur?
Who needs reading glasses to recognize a perfectly straight neighborhood lane?
All right, lead the expedition, Captain, while I count every turn in my notebook.
Left past the flower pots, left again past the green fence — where are we going?!
亚瑟既没理会黄铜指南针，也没戴上自己的老花镜，得意洋洋地带着大家钻进了一条弯弯曲曲的小巷。我们下一幕见。
See you next time!
